name: Jeroboam
summary: A servant of Solomon to whom the prophet Ahijah promised ten tribes of Israel. He became their king but made golden calves for the people to worship, and later kings of Israel kept walking in his sins.

key_moments.title: Ten Pieces of a Garment
key_moments.description: The prophet Ahijah met Jeroboam alone in a field outside Jerusalem and tore a new garment into twelve pieces. He told Jeroboam to take ten, for the LORD would give him ten tribes, and when Solomon sought to kill him, Jeroboam fled to Egypt.

key_moments.title: Made King of Israel
key_moments.description: When Rehoboam answered the people harshly at Shechem, the tribes of Israel turned away from the house of David. They called Jeroboam and made him king over all Israel.

key_moments.title: Two Golden Calves
key_moments.description: Jeroboam feared the people would turn back to Rehoboam if they went up to worship in Jerusalem. So he made two calves of gold, set one in Bethel and one in Dan, and told the people these were their gods.

key_moments.title: The Withered Hand
key_moments.description: A man of God from Judah cried out against Jeroboam's altar at Bethel. When Jeroboam stretched out his hand to seize him, it dried up, and it was healed only when the man of God prayed.

key_moments.title: His Wife in Disguise
key_moments.description: When his son Abijah fell sick, Jeroboam sent his wife in disguise to the prophet Ahijah at Shiloh. Ahijah knew her and told her the child would die and evil would come on the house of Jeroboam.
